name: 32380-jsonschema-qwen25coder7b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct. Ungated, 15 GB, already in the local HF cache. No substitution: the requests ask for structured code review, so a code model is not incidental.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. One GPU; no tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
architecture: Qwen2ForCausalLM, 28 layers, 28 query heads over 4 KV heads (GQA), head_dim 128, hidden 3584, intermediate 18944, vocab 152064, rope_theta 1e6, 32768 positions, bf16, 15.2 GB.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 300 requests with an 1800 s safety cap. Admission ceiling 48, written into sglang-config.yaml as `max-running-requests`.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/chat/completions`, single turn, no shared prefix: prompts centred on 512 tokens (stdev 64, clamped 256-768), seed 42, temperature 0. Every request carries the same JSON schema, declared in `scenario.json` under `backend.extras.body.response_format` -- three scalar fields and a `findings` array of 6 to 8 three-field objects. The schema and not a token cap fixes output length at ~250-420 tokens on this tokenizer, which is why `output_tokens` is not declared and `ignore_eos: false` is pinned: guidellm sets `ignore_eos` whenever `output_tokens` is present, and under a grammar the matcher admits only the stop token once the schema terminates. `backend.max_tokens: 1024` is a runaway guard and is not expected to bind.
purpose: A code review assistant returning schema-constrained JSON findings for medium prompts, one user at a time on a single H100.
launch:
# sglang at commit f5155d960286db25952217f343ee0d3c358f7f77, one H100: NGRAM speculative
# decoding on Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct, serving JSON-schema-constrained chat completions.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct

# 16 is not the default and must be written: the speculative arg group sets 12 when it is unset.
speculative-algorithm: NGRAM
speculative-num-draft-tokens: 16

grammar-backend: xgrammar

# These two are ONE choice. With eagle-topk > 1 (10 here, copied from the BFS breadth) the
# speculative arg group refuses page-size > 1 on any backend but flashinfer, and raises at startup.
attention-backend: flashinfer
page-size: 64

mem-fraction-static: 0.8

# Written down because the arg group silently resets it to 48 whenever it is unset.
max-running-requests: 48
